en.title: Uber OA #41: Generate Array
en.description: Given a string array words, return an array of the same length: item i is the first letter of words[i] concatenated with the last letter of the next word words[i+1]. The next word of the last item is words[0].
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n space-separated words. 1≤n≤100000, and each word has length 1..20 and contains only lowercase English letters.
en.output: Output n lines; line i is item i of the result array.
en.explanation:
Example 1: words=["cat","dog","flower","bed"], and the result is cg (c + the g of dog), dr (d + the r of flower), fd (f + the d of bed), bt (b + the t of cat).
Example 2: with a single word ab, the next word is itself, so the result is ab.
Example 3: ["ab","cd"] gives ad and cb.
hints: The index of the next word for item i is (i+1) mod n.
Remember that the last item wraps around to the first word.
